risk_note: RV2 (settlement clawback path; events only, no new money movement). FU-SETTLE-ADJ-NOTIFY publisher (orchestrator D10-773 B, D10-816 ②, D10-817). settleDiff's R10 negative route now publishes order.settle_adjusted with events.publish(trx, …) in the same sync transaction, after the SETTLE_ADJUST vouchers, obligations, order CAS and history (a publish failure rolls everything back): { order_id, order_key, settle_seq, sub_type 'SETTLE_DIFF', beneficiaries [{ user_id, role, adjust_fen (signed decimal string, = delta_fen), bucket ('bad_debt' when posting is bad_debt, else 'user_available') }] } for delta_fen != 0; the platform difference is not listed; published with beneficiaries [] when only the platform moves (rule test). apply step 10: order.clawed_back for R9 now carries reason = the R9 sub_type (cause RIGHTS -> RIGHTS, PARTIAL_REFUND -> PART_REFUND); R8 unchanged. Positive / no-change / held paths publish nothing. Consumer B1-12zc (#2617) reads this payload. Existing settlement spec tests reaching R9 / R10 were read one by one: R9 payload checks use toMatchObject / objectContaining; the fake buses that refuse other events (forfeited-state/kit.ts, admin-recon-restore/after-restore) never reach R10; none expected red, confirmed by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml #21; D10-772).
